turns.prompt: scan_a and scan_b (Bruker BES3T) are CW-EPR spectra of the same sample, same settings except the modulation amplitude. Is one of them overmodulated? Report the modulation amplitude in G of the overmodulated scan (overmodulated_modamp_G, null if neither), and the ratio of the double integrals after normalising each by its modulation amplitude, b over a (di_ratio_normalised).

provenance: synthetic, exact first-harmonic modulation kernel, s8.cw_overmodulation
